items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: In fact, I'm the one who set up the Sundown Supper Club for him to work.

ctx.x: Is Israel Augustine the same? He was a DJ?
He was a DJ. He worked part time in the evening. In fact, I'm the one who set up the Sundown Supper Club for him to work. How'd you like that?
What was the Sundown Supper Club?
